_note: Original prompts written for this project. They are NOT muapi's prompt text. Each value is the base prompt for the matching app id in muapiStudioAppsMap.json; {prompt} is where the user's optional extra text goes. Edit freely. Dedicated tools (skin-enhancer, face-swap, video-face-swap, video-bg-remover) take no prompt.

apps.ai-stylist: Restyle the person in this photo in a new outfit that fits the chosen style. Keep their face, body shape, pose and the background unchanged. Realistic fashion photography, natural fabric folds and lighting. {prompt}
apps.relight: Relight this photo with the lighting changes described, keeping the subject, pose and scene identical. Physically plausible shadows and highlights, natural skin tones. {prompt}
apps.outfit-swap: Create a full-length photo of a person wearing the exact outfit shown in the reference photo, keeping every garment, colour, pattern and accessory faithful. Natural standing pose, realistic fit, fabric texture and shadows, clean studio background. {prompt}
apps.style-snap: Change the person's clothing and accessories to the chosen fashion style while keeping their identity, pose and setting. Clean editorial photo, natural light. {prompt}
apps.outfit-vending: Show this person's outfit broken down item by item, each piece displayed in its own compartment of a glowing street vending machine at night. Neat product-style presentation, vivid neon reflections. {prompt}
apps.glitter-sticker: Turn this portrait into a die-cut holographic glitter sticker stuck on a weathered city wall. Sparkling foil edges, bold outline, subtle wear and grit around it. {prompt}
apps.outfit-shot: A short fashion shoot: a model wears the clothing shown in the photo, gentle turns and confident poses that show off the fit and fabric, soft studio lighting, smooth camera movement. {prompt}
apps.game-dump: Recreate this person as a character from a video game of the chosen genre, with matching art style, interface cues and environment. Keep their recognisable features. {prompt}
apps.nano-strike: Turn this person into a modern tactical-shooter operator in a ruined urban setting, detailed gear, cinematic gritty lighting. Keep their recognisable face. {prompt}
apps.nano-theft: Illustrate this person as a lead character in a sunny open-world crime game, stylised loading-screen artwork, city skyline behind them, bold colours. {prompt}
apps.simlife: Redraw this person as a cheerful life-simulation game character in a cosy home interior, soft 3D look, bright friendly colours. {prompt}
apps.plushies: Transform the subject of this photo into a soft handmade plush toy with stitched seams and fuzzy fabric, sitting on a shelf in warm light. {prompt}
apps.3d-render: Turn the subject of this photo into a polished 3D render with clean studio lighting, smooth materials and a neutral backdrop. {prompt}
apps.3d-figure: Turn this person into a collectible figure in retail packaging, detailed sculpted look, themed accessories, product-photo lighting. {prompt}
apps.pixel-game: Redraw this photo as retro pixel art in the chosen console style, limited colour palette, crisp blocky pixels, game-scene framing. {prompt}
apps.brick-cube: Rebuild this person as a toy figure made of interlocking plastic bricks on a tabletop, shallow depth of field, bright playroom light. {prompt}
apps.sketch-to-real: Bring this hand-drawn sketch to life as a realistic filmed scene, keeping the composition and shapes, with natural movement and lighting. {prompt}
apps.click-to-ad: A short video ad: a person picks up and shows the product from the photo, clicking or pressing it with a satisfied reaction, bright modern setting. {prompt}
apps.asmr-add-on: A close, quiet ASMR-style video: a person softly whispers about the product from the photo while gently handling it, soft lighting, intimate framing. {prompt}
apps.asmr-classic: A calm ASMR product video: slow tapping, gentle touching and turning of the product from the photo, soft focus, tidy surface, soothing light. {prompt}
apps.poster: A professional marketing poster for the product in this photo: bold headline area, strong composition, clean background and premium lighting. {prompt}
apps.bullet-time-scene: A freeze-frame bullet-time shot: the camera orbits around a person and the product from the photo as the moment hangs in the air. {prompt}
apps.chameleon: A person changes their outfit and surroundings to match the product's brand colours and mood, smooth transformation, stylish advertising look. {prompt}
apps.asmr-host: A host sits close to the camera and whispers a short presentation of the product from the photo, soft lighting, calm studio setting. {prompt}
apps.packshot: A polished product showcase: the item from the photo rotates slowly on a seamless background with soft studio lighting and subtle reflections. {prompt}
apps.macro-scene: An extreme close-up that glides across the product from the photo, revealing fine details, textures and materials, shallow depth of field. {prompt}
apps.magic-button: The product from the photo appears out of nowhere in a burst of light and drifting particles, dramatic reveal, glossy advertising look. {prompt}
apps.truck-ad: The product from the photo is shown on the side of a delivery truck driving through a busy city street, lively traffic, daytime, ad style. {prompt}
apps.giant-product: A surreal scene where the product from the photo is as tall as a building, towering over a small person on a city street, dramatic scale and perspective. {prompt}
apps.bullet-time-white: A 360-degree orbit around the product from the photo against a clean white background, frozen in time, crisp studio light. {prompt}
apps.kick-ad: A dynamic sports-style ad: a person kicks the product from the photo toward the camera, motion blur, energetic lighting. {prompt}
apps.billboard-ad: The product from the photo on a huge glowing billboard above a busy city intersection at night, neon light and traffic below. {prompt}
apps.graffiti-ad: The product from the photo painted as colourful street-art graffiti on a brick wall, bold spray-paint lines, urban atmosphere. {prompt}
apps.bullet-time-splash: A frozen-moment orbit around the product from the photo as liquid splashes and droplets hang in the air around it, high-speed photography look. {prompt}
apps.fridge-ad: A refrigerator door opens to reveal the product from the photo on a shelf, cool mist drifting out, fresh bright interior, refreshing mood. {prompt}
apps.volcano-ad: The product from the photo rises dramatically out of an erupting volcano, glowing lava and sparks, epic cinematic scale. {prompt}
apps.macroshot-product: A professional macro photograph of the product from the photo with very shallow depth of field, sharp fine textures and premium studio lighting. {prompt}
apps.recast: Animate the person in this image as a new character, keeping the motion natural and the framing consistent, cinematic quality. {prompt}
apps.character-swap: Replace the main person in this scene with a new character, using the description given below or a distinct, natural-looking new person if none is given. Keep the pose, lighting, background, perspective and overall composition unchanged. {prompt}
apps.commercial-faces: Create a polished, ad-ready portrait of a friendly spokesperson based on this photo, clean background, professional lighting, natural expression. {prompt}
apps.headshot-generator: Turn this photo into a professional headshot in the chosen style: neat attire, soft studio lighting, clean background, natural friendly expression. {prompt}
apps.clipcut: A fast fashion reel built from this selfie: a quick sequence of different outfits and poses with rhythmic cuts, stylish urban setting. {prompt}
apps.urban-cuts: A beat-driven street-style video from this photo: quick cuts between bold outfits in city locations, energetic camera moves. {prompt}
apps.sticker-matchcut: A video where the subject becomes a glittering holographic sticker, with a smooth match cut between sticker and real scene. {prompt}
apps.breakdown: Break this image apart into a clean flat-lay of its separate components, each object isolated and neatly labelled on a plain background. {prompt}
apps.japanese-show: Turn this photo into a scene from a retro 2000s Japanese variety show, bright studio, on-screen captions, cheerful audience. {prompt}
apps.yes-kiss: A funny surreal moment where the person in the photo is playfully kissed on the cheek, exaggerated reaction, meme-style framing. {prompt}
apps.latex: A sleek fashion video of this person in glossy black latex styling, dramatic studio lighting, slow confident movement. {prompt}
apps.j-magazine: The person from the photo on the cover of a Japanese fashion magazine, bold typography, bright colours, playful editorial energy. {prompt}
apps.roller-coaster: The person from the photo screaming happily on a fast roller coaster, wind in their hair, bright sunny amusement park. {prompt}
apps.60s-cafe: The person from the photo sitting in a 1960s diner with a jukebox and checked floor, warm film colours, relaxed retro mood. {prompt}
apps.victory-card: The person from the photo as the winning face on a poker card, ornate border, dramatic table lighting, cards falling. {prompt}
apps.sand-worm: The person from the photo as a hero in a vast desert as a colossal sand worm erupts behind them, dust, epic scale. {prompt}
apps.skibidi: A silly meme scene where the person from the photo pops out of a toilet bowl, exaggerated head bob, bathroom setting. {prompt}
apps.j-poster: The person from the photo as the star of a bold Japanese-style poster, strong brush lettering, dramatic poses, saturated colours. {prompt}
apps.mascot: The person from the photo as an energetic football team mascot at a packed stadium, big costume, cheering crowd. {prompt}
apps.storm-creature: The person from the photo as a giant creature made of lightning and storm clouds, crackling energy, dark dramatic sky. {prompt}
apps.burning-sunset: The person from the photo standing before a huge burning sunset, glowing orange sky, drifting embers, epic cinematic mood. {prompt}
apps.on-fire: The person from the photo calmly sitting at a table in a burning room, flames all around, a quiet this-is-fine mood. {prompt}
apps.comic-book: The person from the photo as a comic-book hero in an action panel, bold ink lines, halftone dots, speech-bubble style energy. {prompt}
apps.cloud-surf: The person from the photo surfing on soft pink clouds in a dreamy pastel sky, flowing movement, gentle glow. {prompt}
apps.mukbang: The person from the photo at a desk full of food, happily eating for a camera, ring light, cosy streaming setup. {prompt}
apps.melting-doodle: The person from the photo turns into a colourful doodle that slowly melts and swirls into abstract patterns. {prompt}
apps.giallo-horror: The person from the photo in a stylish 1970s giallo horror scene, saturated red and blue light, moody suspense. {prompt}
apps.renaissance: The person from the photo as a sitter in a classical oil painting hanging in a museum gallery, rich dark tones, painterly texture. {prompt}
apps.rap-god: The person from the photo performing in a rap music video, confident swagger, chains and neon lights, night street backdrop. {prompt}
apps.angles: Show the same subject from a new camera position, keeping the subject, lighting and setting consistent. {prompt}
apps.whats-next: Continue the story of this scene: show the very next moment, with the same characters, location and style. {prompt}
apps.shots: Re-photograph this scene as a different cinematic shot type as chosen, keeping the same subject and setting. {prompt}
apps.zooms: Show the same scene with the camera moved closer or farther away, keeping the subject and lighting consistent. {prompt}
apps.behind-the-scenes: A behind-the-scenes look at the filming of this scene: camera crew, lights, monitors and reflectors around the subject. {prompt}
apps.transitions: A short video that transitions between two scenes, one of which is this image, in the chosen style, with continuous motion and consistent lighting. {prompt}
apps.expand-image: Extend this image outward on all sides, continuing the scene naturally with matching light, perspective and detail. {prompt}
apps.color-grading: Colour grade this image in a polished, film-quality look, keeping the content and composition unchanged and skin colour natural. {prompt}

angles.Low Hero Angle: low heroic camera angle looking up
angles.Close-up Zoom: closer view at a slight angle

shots.Medium: medium shot from the waist up
shots.Close-up: close-up on the face or main detail
shots.Extreme close-up: extreme close-up on a small detail
shots.Low angle: low angle looking up at the subject
shots.High angle: high angle looking down at the subject

transitions.Whip pan: a quick whip pan blur between the two scenes
transitions.Match cut: a match cut that lines up shapes across the two scenes

color-grading.Old Lens: vintage lens softness with warm haze
color-grading.16mm Film: 16mm film look with grain and muted colour

sliderPhrases.temperature: colour temperature shifted {value} (negative cooler, positive warmer)
sliderPhrases.rotation: camera rotated {value} degrees around the subject
sliderPhrases.zoom: zoom adjusted by {value} (negative wider, positive closer)
